beats.say: A post argues that compressing RAM is a better answer than buying more memory, explaining how compression can stretch available memory.

Recently I was running out of memory, I found my solution in zram, a solution to compress memory. Often the CPUs were under little stress, so we could have avoided upgrading if we had enabled RAM compression.
Unfortunately not all Linux environments have RAM compression enabled by default. Compressing memory does come with small, but not really noticeable.
